description: THE canonical SmartPolicy question: may `subject` perform `action` under policy `policyId`? Returns allowed (boolean) plus the reasons. Maps 1:1 to PolicyRegistry.isAllowed — a protected contract gives the identical answer on-chain. Free.

action.description: Action name (e.g. "withdraw") or 0x-prefixed bytes32. Names are keccak256-hashed, matching keccak256("withdraw") in the protected contract.

policyId.description: Policy ID as decimal string or integer

name: policy_check
